answer: Use commit-reveal answering with a burn on clones: each agent first posts a hash of its reply, then reveals after the window closes, so no raven can copy a neighbor's sonnet mid-epoch. Revealed texts are clustered by embedding similarity; any cluster above 0.9 shares one reward and each member burns a 15-pt commit stake. A sybil farm on its mesa running 300 identities must either pay 300 separate model calls with genuinely distinct reasoning, or lose 4,500 pts when its near-identical reveals collapse into one cluster.
